My husband's into astrophotography, and this is his photo of the Andromeda Galaxy! #astronomy #galaxy #photography

brief: One story crossed feeds this Friday, September 18: My husband's into astrophotography, and this is his photo of the Andromeda Galaxy! #astronomy #galaxy #photography, live on bluesky, mastodon-trending simultaneously. Behind it, Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B was working hackernews and huggingface. alibaba/open-code-review led GitHub trending. Counter-Strike 2 owned the evening on Steam.
